eventPayload.title: Event payload
eventPayload.description: The event body as a JSON object, matching the event definition's payload contract. Must be an object — the engine rejects an array.

requestBody.description: Input for acquiring (locking) external worker jobs of a single topic. The engine locks up to numberOfTasks jobs for the given workerId; only that worker may then complete, fail or raise a BPMN error on them.

schema.title: flow_external_worker_job_acquire input
schema.description: Input for acquiring (locking) external worker jobs of a single topic. The engine locks up to numberOfTasks jobs for the given workerId; only that worker may then complete, fail or raise a BPMN error on them.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The external-worker topic to pull work from (flowable:topic on the service task). Jobs are acquired per topic — one call, one topic.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker taking the lock. Must be repeated on the follow-up complete/fail/bpmnError/unacquire call.

lockDuration.title: Lock duration
lockDuration.description: How long the lock is held, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT10M). Once it expires the engine hands the job to the next worker, so it must comfortably exceed the expected processing time.

numberOfTasks.title: Number of tasks
numberOfTasks.description: Maximum number of jobs to lock in this call (batch size).

numberOfRetries.title: Number of retries
numberOfRetries.description: Retries the acquired jobs are given. Once they are used up the engine dead-letters the job instead of re-scheduling it.

scopeType.title: Scope type
scopeType.description: Restrict acquisition to jobs of one engine (BPMN processes or CMMN cases). Omit to acquire regardless of scope.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).

requestBody.description: Input for raising a BPMN error from an acquired external worker job. Unlike fail (a technical failure the engine retries) this is a MODELLED outcome: the process continues along the error boundary event that catches the given errorCode.

schema.title: flow_external_worker_job_bpmn_error input
schema.description: Input for raising a BPMN error from an acquired external worker job. Unlike fail (a technical failure the engine retries) this is a MODELLED outcome: the process continues along the error boundary event that catches the given errorCode.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: The BPMN error code to raise; must match an errorEventDefinition in the process, otherwise the error escapes uncaught.

variables.description: Variables to set before the error is raised: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).

requestBody.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as done. The variables become process variables, so the following BPMN steps can read the worker's result.

schema.title: flow_external_worker_job_complete input
schema.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as done. The variables become process variables, so the following BPMN steps can read the worker's result.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

variables.description: Result variables: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).

requestBody.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as failed. The ENGINE owns what happens next: it decrements the retries and re-schedules the job, or dead-letters it once they are used up. Use unacquire instead when the worker simply cannot do the work — failing spends a retry.

schema.title: flow_external_worker_job_fail input
schema.description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as failed. The ENGINE owns what happens next: it decrements the retries and re-schedules the job, or dead-letters it once they are used up. Use unacquire instead when the worker simply cannot do the work — failing spends a retry.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Override the remaining attempts. Omit to let the engine decrement the current value; 0 dead-letters the job immediately.

retryTimeout.title: Retry timeout
retryTimeout.description: How long to wait before the job becomes acquirable again, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT5M).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Short reason, shown as the job's exceptionMessage in the job store.

errorDetails.title: Error details
errorDetails.description: Long-form detail (e.g. a stacktrace), retrievable via GET /jobs/{id}/stacktrace.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).

requestBody.description: Input for releasing the lock on an acquired external worker job. The job becomes acquirable again WITHOUT consuming one of its retries — the right report when the worker cannot do the work at all (no handler for the topic, or a shutdown while the job was held).

workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.
